artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan for the shared sapience-api-lib.sh, the confirm-or-refuse project binder, the read-only vault aggregator, their two test suites, and the manifest/lockstep registration edits.

memory_candidates.content: An extension's manifest.json provides.scripts array is an explicit, hand-maintained list that deploy and check-extension-docs.sh Rule Q both read; a new script absent from it neither deploys nor lints clean, and nothing surfaces that at authoring time. sync-manifest-scripts.sh --check/--write is the sanctioned regenerator, but it enumerates via `git ls-files`, so a newly created script must be STAGED before --write can see it. Any plan that adds a script to an extension therefore owes both a manifest.json entry in its Files to modify block and a stage-then-regenerate ordering in its task list.
